snippet.title: Vitrified - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Vitrified on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2571610/Vitrified/

Vitrified is an open-world survival adventure. Stranded in the post-nuclear wasteland, you must fight, explore and survive to find your way home. Join forces with ALAN to battle giant mutant creatures, and overcome the dangers of the desert.

If you're a subscriber and are confused, I used to make Lego animations in the golden days of stop-motion Youtube! Nowadays I spend a lot of my time making games. I hope you find this cool!
